description: Na₂ZrSe₃ is Caswellsilverite-like structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/m space group. There are three inequivalent Na¹⁺ sites. In the first Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six Se²⁻ atoms to form NaSe₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaSe₆ octahedra, edges with six NaSe₆ octahedra, and edges with six equivalent ZrSe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 9-10°. There are two shorter (2.93 Å) and four longer (2.94 Å) Na-Se bond lengths. In the second Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six Se²⁻ atoms to form NaSe₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaSe₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent ZrSe₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent ZrSe₆ octahedra, and edges with eight NaSe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 8-10°. There are two shorter (2.86 Å) and four longer (3.06 Å) Na-Se bond lengths. In the third Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six Se²⁻ atoms to form NaSe₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaSe₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent ZrSe₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent ZrSe₆ octahedra, and edges with eight NaSe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 9°. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.91-3.08 Å. Zr⁴⁺ is bonded to six Se²⁻ atoms to form ZrSe₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaSe₆ octahedra, edges with three equivalent ZrSe₆ octahedra, and edges with nine NaSe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 8-9°. There are a spread of Zr-Se bond distances ranging from 2.70-2.73 Å. There are two inequivalent Se²⁻ sites. In the first Se²⁻ site, Se²⁻ is bonded to four Na¹⁺ and two equivalent Zr⁴⁺ atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SeNa₄Zr₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-10°. In the second Se²⁻ site, Se²⁻ is bonded to four Na¹⁺ and two equivalent Zr⁴⁺ atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SeNa₄Zr₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-7°.
